d:
Teen Dost sees the trio reflect on their journey so far - about how they went from uncertainty and doubting whether hip-hop would ever allow them to fulfil their dreams to being recognised as three of the most influential creative talents in the country.
Directed by Anurag Sharma
Producer: Jatin Tambe
Executive Producer: Mo Joshi
Music Credits
Written & Performed by Seedhe Maut, Sez on the Beat
Produced/ Mixed/ Mastered by Sez on the Beat
Label: Azadi Records / THE MVMNT
